limitations: GH2/LNG-informed Bayesian LH2 estimates, not independently validated against LH2 field leak experience.
Discrete fractional flow-area bins; do not interpolate, smooth, or add Purple LOCs for the same physical scope.
Five published medians retained; distribution bounds use published ln-rate mu/sigma.
Pipe exposure is metre-years (HyRAM+ manual), not the number of arbitrary pipe objects.
Vessel bins need an explicitly reviewed reference flow diameter; do not use vessel diameter.
This event is allocated to one reviewed physical location with an explicit location_weight; the remaining exposure needs separate physical scope rows.
Marginal lognormal bounds; cross-bin correlation is unavailable, so summed bounds are not facility credible intervals.
